attributes.name: section intro alignment
attributes.definition: Text alignment of the heading and introductory content within a page section.

values.definition: Mixed or other alignment, or not stated.

attributes.name: section intro call-to-action
attributes.definition: Whether a section's intro includes a call-to-action button and how it is styled.

values.definition: One call-to-action button in an accent color follows the intro text.
A button present with a non-accent or multiple-button treatment.
No call-to-action in the section intro.

attributes.name: section heading kicker
attributes.definition: Presence and style of a small eyebrow/kicker line above section headings.

values.definition: Small kicker line above heading in accent color using a handwritten/script typeface.
Small kicker line in uppercase sans-serif text.
Kicker present in some other style.
